reviewer: Claude (visual review at 4x on contact sheets, 2026-11-27); pending human art review
note: Manual verdicts the automatic checks cannot make (facing, pose, cropping) and the visual call on borderline background remnants. Keys are body/Action/DIR/frame; a trailing * covers every frame of that row. tools/painted_candidates.py merges these with the automatic checks into qa.json.

reject.male/Idle/NE/*: facing: right-facing profile with the face visible (reads as E/SE), not a back three-quarter NE view
reject.male/Walk/NE/*: facing: right-facing profile with the face visible (reads as E/SE), not NE
reject.male/Cast/NE/*: facing: right-facing profile with the face visible (reads as E/SE), not NE
reject.male/Unarmed_Attack/NE/*: facing: right-facing profile with the face visible (reads as E/SE), not NE
reject.female/Idle/NE/*: facing: right-facing profile with the face visible (reads as E/SE), not NE
reject.female/Walk/NE/*: facing: right-facing profile with the face visible (reads as E/SE), not NE
reject.female/Cast/NE/*: facing: right-facing profile with the face visible (reads as E/SE), not NE
reject.female/Unarmed_Attack/NE/*: facing: right-facing profile with the face visible (reads as E/SE), not NE
reject.male/Walk/NW/*: facing: chest and face toward the viewer (reads as SW/W), not a back three-quarter NW view
reject.male/Unarmed_Attack/NW/00: facing: chest toward the viewer (reads as SW), not NW
reject.female/Unarmed_Attack/NW/*: facing: chest toward the viewer (reads as SW), not NW
reject.female/Unarmed_Attack/S/*: pose: arms at rest in all three candidates; no strike is visible
reject.male/Cast/E/02: cropping: the top of the head is cut off and the raised arm is broken
reject.female/Idle/E/02: alpha: dark background remnant behind the rear leg (visible at 1x)
reject.female/Idle/SW/00: alpha: dark background remnant behind the rear leg (visible at 1x)
reject.female/Walk/N/01: alpha: dark background remnant between the legs (visible at 1x)

accept_despite_metric.male/Idle/SE/00: dark-pixel count comes from leg shading; no remnant visible
accept_despite_metric.male/Idle/SE/01: dark-pixel count comes from leg shading; no remnant visible
accept_despite_metric.male/Cast/N/02: dark-pixel count comes from leg shading; no remnant visible

warnings.*/Idle/{SW,W,NW,NE,E,SE}: Idle side views are painted mid-stride, so idle and walk read alike from the side
warnings.*/Cast: Cast is one unsplit candidate set, not CastPrepare / CastHold / CastRelease
warnings.male/Cast/*: male Cast and Unarmed_Attack poses are very close; the cast gesture reads as a punch
